name: Library Component
description: The platform library component's own catalogue (@laic/library-core): scoped instances (personal/program/org), copy-with-provenance distribution, partner packaging. Everyone READS and EDITS their own shelf by ownership; every other move is a capability — including creating on your own shelf (library.author.own, granted broadly by default so revoking it makes a role play-only). Host platforms may embed this as a group (bridge does) or bind it directly via cross-catalogue role grants.

capabilities.label: Create items in your own library
capabilities.description: Create boards, deals and tables on your personal shelf. REQUIRED to create: no prebuilt role (learner, coach…) may author without it — grant it to a role to allow practice authoring. Without it a role is play-only: it still receives shared, assigned and designated content.

capabilities.label: Author into the program library instance
capabilities.description: Create, edit and delete items on the program's shared shelf

capabilities.label: Author into the organization library instance
capabilities.description: Create, edit and delete items on the organization's shared shelf

capabilities.label: Assign/copy library items to people
capabilities.description: Copy items into other people's instances (assign, share)

capabilities.label: Embed library items into external documents
capabilities.description: Snapshot items into external documents (e.g. lessons)

capabilities.label: Publish library packages for partners
capabilities.description: Package program/org content for partner organizations

capabilities.label: Install published library packages
capabilities.description: Install a partner's published package into this instance

resourceTypes.label: Library item
resourceTypes.description: One item in a scoped library instance; kinds are host-defined (bridge: deal/board/table/play/drill/puzzle)

groups.label: Instances
groups.description: Creating on your own shelf, and reading/authoring the shared (program/org) instances

groups.label: Distribution
groups.description: Moving copies between instances: assign/share to people, embed into external documents

groups.label: Partnerships
groups.description: Publishing packages for partner organizations and installing theirs (Phase C)

sampleRoleTemplates.name: Distributor
sampleRoleTemplates.description: Shares and assigns content to people (what coaches effectively hold)

sampleRoleTemplates.name: Partnership Manager
sampleRoleTemplates.description: Publishes packages to partners and installs theirs
